verdict.rationale: The product is a processor, and open hardware designs and firmware exist, so asking whether its source is openly licensed is a fair axis. The pack has no evidence that the chip's design, firmware, or core Ryzen AI runtime is published under an open license. The only open-source items are companion ecosystem software (the Lemonade SDK and the GAIA agent framework), which is adjacent and not the product's own source.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
